title:
Parent type for all Tuple representations of a C3 Data. Each Data.Tuple subtype represents a single column of data
in a pandas DataFrame. They are specifically used for Data backed by tuples (e.g. Data constructed from `eval`).
Different Data.Tuple subtypes have specialized ser/deser optimizations to improve data transfer time between the
client and the server
name: Data.TupleBase
